title: The FCC chief's call for cracking down on tech companies is not only laughable, it's the ‘height of hypocrisy' (GOOGL, FB, AAPL, TWTR)
text: The FCC chief’s call for cracking down on tech companies is not only laughable, it’s the ‘height of hypocrisy’ (GOOGL, FB, AAPL, TWTR) By Troy Wolverton Sep 6, 2018, 7:48 pm 33 pts Ajit Pai, chairman of the Federal Communications Commission, earlier this week called for tech companies such as Facebook and Twitter to disclose more information about how they operate their services and about their privacy practices.
